brief:
The petroleum authority in Gaza announced Sunday that five trucks carrying cooking gas had entered the enclave, the Shehab Wire reported. The shipment marks a delivery of fuel supplies to the territory as supply concerns persist in the coastal strip.

The authority did not immediately disclose the origin of the consignment, which distribution points within Gaza would receive the gas, or how the arrival would affect overall fuel availability across the enclave. Cooking gas shortages have been a chronic concern for residents relying on the fuel for heating and food preparation.
